processors.name: Convert Record From JSON to CSV

properties.Extract Date Elements:
SELECT
    transaction_id,
    transaction_timestamp,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(transaction_timestamp AS DATE)) AS transaction_day_of_month,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(transaction_timestamp AS DATE)) AS transaction_month,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CAST(transaction_timestamp AS DATE)) AS transaction_quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(transaction_timestamp AS DATE)) AS transaction_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM CAST(transaction_timestamp AS DATE)) AS transaction_day_of_week,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CAST(transaction_timestamp AS DATE)) AS transaction_week_of_year,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM CAST(transaction_timestamp AS DATE)) AS transaction_day_of_year,
    vehicle_type,
    fastag_id,
    toll_booth_id,
    lane_type,
    vehicle_dims,
    transaction_amount,
    amount_paid,
    geo_location,
    vehicle_speed,
    vehicle_plate_number,
    fraud_indicator
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Handle Nulls & Missing Data:
SELECT
    transaction_id,
	transaction_timestamp,
    CASE vehicle_type
        WHEN 'Bus ' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Car' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Motorcycle' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Sedan' THEN 3
        WHEN 'SUV' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Truck' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Van' THEN 6
        ELSE -1
    END AS vehicle_type,
    CASE toll_booth_id
        WHEN 'A-101' THEN 0
        WHEN 'B-102' THEN 1
        WHEN 'D-104' THEN 2
        WHEN 'C-103' THEN 3
        WHEN 'D-105' THEN 4
        WHEN 'D-106' THEN 5
        ELSE -1
    END AS toll_booth_id,
    CASE lane_type
        WHEN 'Express' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Regular' THEN 1
        ELSE -1
    END AS lane_type,
    CASE vehicle_dims
        WHEN 'Small' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Large' THEN 2
        ELSE -1
    END AS vehicle_dims,
    transaction_amount,
    amount_paid,
    geo_location,
    vehicle_speed,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM vehicle_plate_number) AS vehicle_plate_number,
    CASE fraud_indicator
        WHEN 'Not Fraud' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Fraud' THEN 1
        ELSE -1
    END AS fraud_indicator
FROM FLOWFILE
